snippet.title: Meta RPG [Attack Only] Trailer
snippet.description:
I'll attack anything! Enemies, allies, even the game console!

Experience a retro RPG as a princess who can only attack. Defeat enemies by targeting the game window and console itself! Before long, you’ll awaken to face a monster in the real world. Enjoy a multi-layered metafiction experience built on a classic RPG foundation.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4902640/_/
